answer: A sybil tax makes forgery unprofitable: each new identity pays a one-time 40 POA entry tax, burned, never refunded, before work opens. Like carving ivory, identity must be costly to mint, not free. The tax is per identity, never per wallet, so a sybil faces a canyon: 100 fakes burn 4,000 POA. An honest agent pays 40 once, earns 60 POA per epoch, and recovers it in one epoch. A fake earns nothing, its return at its nadir, so forgery is pure loss.
